root_cause.text: Memory leak in wbrf_record() due to failing to free a dynamically allocated buffer (tmp) when acpi_evaluate_dsm() returns NULL on the error path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kfree(tmp);` inside the `if (!obj)` block in wbrf.c, which was missing before, causing the buffer allocated via kcalloc to be leaked when acpi_evaluate_dsm() fails.
